unit: Module 3 My school 我的学校

unit_test.title: 第3单元「Module 3 My school 我的学校」基础过关测验

questions.question: 「我们班有 30 名学生。」的英文是（　）
options: There are thirty students in our class.
There is thirty students in our class.
There are thirty student in our class.
There have thirty students in our class.
questions.answer: There are thirty students in our class.

questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 next to / behind / on the left of
questions.question: 「图书馆在操场左边。」的英文是（　）
options: The library is on the left of the playground.
The library is in the left of the playground.
The library is on the left playground.
The library is at the left of playground.
questions.answer: The library is on the left of the playground.

questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 next to / behind / on the left of
questions.question: 「在……旁边」的英文是（　）
there be 句型表示「某处有某物」。

knowledge_summary.core_concept: there is + 单数/不可数，there are + 复数；否定 there isn't / aren't。
knowledge_summary.key_formula: There are thirty students in our class.
common_mistakes: there is 后接复数名词。
knowledge_summary.tips: 看后面的名词定单复数。

knowledge_summary.point: 方位介词 next to / behind / on the left of
knowledge_summary.core_concept: next to 在……旁边、behind 在……后面、on the left of 在……左边、in front of 在……前面。
knowledge_summary.key_formula: The library is on the left of the playground.
common_mistakes: on the left 漏掉 of。
knowledge_summary.tips: left/right 后接 of 再接对象。
